summary: Represent unavailable Wireless Debugging as non-critical standby while canonical ADB is healthy, with zero readiness retry/human escalation.
reason: Samsung repeatedly resets adb_wifi_enabled while canonical 127.0.0.1:5556 remains healthy; proactive recovery readiness must not behave like a current service failure.

tests.name: adb-readiness-targeted
tests.evidence: test-adb-recovery-readiness.py, test-adb-recovery-readiness-watchdog.sh and test-health-verdict.py pass on the isolated candidate.

tests.name: live-standby-acceptance
tests.evidence: Pending immutable release deployment and live receipt verification.

capabilities.reason: Existing readiness semantics change from proactive degraded/hysteresis behavior to explicit non-critical standby while primary ADB is healthy.

architecture.reason: Uses the existing readiness helper, ADB watchdog, Incident Orchestrator and health verdict; no new owner or control plane.

rollback: Promote the prior Tier-0 LKG and revert this source commit.
limitations: Standby does not claim that future Wireless Debugging recovery will succeed.
Actual canonical ADB loss still depends on the existing bounded recovery path and may require owner action after deterministic exhaustion.
